documentation.source:
# Intended constraint

Review references to `/v1/legacy` in service notes before changing the endpoint.

## What is detected

The literal string anywhere in a `.txt` file under `src/`; this is a text review trigger, not a URL parser.

## How to review

Inspect the owning note and verify the current routing behavior. If accepting a reference based on a routing file, record its digest as an explicit watched dependency.

## Known limitations

This detector does not classify the endpoint as broken, inspect other file types, or watch future files merely because they are mentioned here.

## Evidence

Synthetic example only; the raw-positive acceptable note is not an application regression test.

## Change history
